_doc: Buildings of the warp-only outdoor maps (b2tools/world.py standalone groups) in their own exterior pack (b2tools/patches/standalone.py builds it from pack 0's models they place plus these), res range 470-499 (format as data/buildings/slice.json). Models: b2tools/models_standalone.py -> work/buildings/standalone/<name>.nsbmd (HOENN_STANDALONE_BUILDINGS: another folder); their textures: textures.txt there (Black 2 sets, merged byte for byte into the pack's texture set). Pokemon Center/Mart/Gym are pack 0's res 0/3/320 (copied into the pack). door 65535 = no door model; dx as data/buildings/towns5.json (doors 259-261: door tile centre - footprint centre + 8; door_pc 93: + 0); dz = the model's front wall.
